title: Two Doors, One Backend
missionBriefing: The storefront has internal and NodePort Services. Both objects exist, but neither provides the intended path to the healthy backend. Repair both without recreating the Deployment.
successCriteria: store-internal is ClusterIP and targets port 80.
store-external is NodePort 30080 and targets port 80.
hints: A NodePort still depends on the selector and EndpointSlice chain.
Repair store-internal targetPort and store-external selector; preserve NodePort 30080.
